_comment: THE INDEX OF QA CATALOGUES. Every file that DECLARES test cases (as `### TC-... — Title` headings) must be listed here, because `npm run check:coverage-gaps` reads this index to decide what 'catalogued' means. A catalogue that is not indexed is invisible: its cases are reported as never written, even when they are written and passing. `npm run check:catalogue-index` fails the build if a tracked .md declares cases and appears in neither list. Adding a per-feature suite is one line here.

_ambiguousNote: Ids declared in more than one catalogue. A test naming one cannot be attributed to a single case, so check-coverage-gaps counts it as neither covered nor gap. These are grandfathered; check-catalogue-index fails on any NEW one. Fixing them means renaming the bare TC-NN ids in references/test-cases.md and edit-order-rbac-test-cases.md to prefixed forms.
